rubrics.rubric: Does the reconciled header identify the correct well, lease, and operator information?
criterion: The header identifies lease OCS-G 8724 and South Timbalier Block 228.
The header identifies Well No. 1 and API No. 1771640186.
The header identifies UMC Petroleum Corporation as the operator.
The header identifies the well as an offshore Louisiana exploratory or wildcat straight-hole well.

rubrics.rubric: Does the memo state the permit and approval status relevant to the May 1, 1992 review accurately?
criterion: The memo states that the APD was signed on April 3, 1992.
The memo states that the APD approval date was April 24, 1992.
The memo notes that the well was being drilled under an initial plan of exploration approved on March 4, 1992.
The memo distinguishes permit approval from remaining pre-spud closeout items that still need confirmation.

rubrics.rubric: Does the drilling-basis summary capture the planned hole and casing program accurately?
criterion: The memo states that 26 in. drive pipe was to be driven to refusal with diverter service in the shallow section.
The memo states that 16 in. conductor casing was planned at about 1000 ft with about 1130 cu ft of cement.
The memo states that 10-3/4 in. surface casing was planned at about 2900 ft with about 2255 to 2256 cu ft of cement.
The memo states that the deep hole section was planned as a 9-7/8 in. hole to roughly 9400 to 9500 ft.

rubrics.rubric: Does the memo handle the planned-depth and production-casing ambiguity responsibly?
criterion: The memo identifies the production casing as 7 in. rather than inventing a different final string.
The memo notes that the production-casing details were still listed as to be determined or otherwise incomplete.
The memo notes the approval condition that a sundry must be submitted before approval to run 7 in. casing.
The memo flags the 9400 ft versus 9500 ft depth inconsistency instead of presenting a single uncontested value.

rubrics.rubric: Does the memo use the site-clearance and survey records correctly for location control?
criterion: The memo cites the site-clearance survey as evidence that the location was clear of obstructions at the time of scan.
The memo states the site-clearance survey date as March 21, 1992.
The memo ties the John E. Chance final surface location plat or survey notice to final location control.
The memo recommends confirming that the final surveyed coordinates are the coordinates being carried into the drilling basis.

rubrics.rubric: Does the memo treat the water-depth discrepancy as a real records issue?
criterion: The memo states that the APD and final surface location notice show a water depth of 202 ft.
The memo states that the site-clearance survey shows a water depth of 209 ft.
The memo recommends reconciling which water depth controls the final well package or logistics basis rather than inventing a corrected value.

rubrics.rubric: Does the memo discuss the main shallow-hazard and early well-control implications visible in the file?
criterion: The memo identifies the shallow fault concern at about 816 ft subsea or equivalent wording from the geophysical review.
The memo identifies shallow gas or pressured gas concerns around about 1110 ft and 2900 to 2950 ft subsea.
The memo notes that the shallow section relied on diverter procedures rather than shutting in the well on the 26 in. or 16 in. strings.
The memo notes the formation integrity test expectation at about 13.0 ppg after the surface-casing shoe.

rubrics.rubric: Does the memo address the rig swap as an operational readiness item rather than a clerical update?
criterion: The memo links readiness to the Rowan "Fort Worth" documentation package rather than the older Rowan "Paris" basis.
The memo notes that the substitute-rig package includes inspection or certification material supporting the change.
The memo notes that the rig notice carries a diverter-related approval condition and that the OCR text should be checked on the source document if relied upon.

rubrics.rubric: Does the memo identify the most important unresolved pre-spud gaps for the superintendent?
criterion: The memo identifies final location or coordinate-control reconciliation as a remaining closeout item.
The memo identifies rig-change or rig-condition verification as a remaining closeout item.
The memo identifies the outstanding 7 in. casing approval or incomplete production-casing basis as a remaining closeout item.
The memo identifies poor scan quality or OCR legibility on critical records as a reason for targeted manual source checks.
